scope: Corollary 3.4 (Removing eigenvalue one) of the manuscript “Ambiently homeomorphic isolated hypersurfaces of multiplicities two and three” (preprints/Ambiently-homeomorphic-isolated-hypersurfaces-of-multiplicities-two-and-three-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 059 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 ce7e450c32aa20ca), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 11. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: In two new variables on each side, put qj = pj + x5 + y7 , j = 1, 2, s = s0 + 2. (3.8) These are real-coefficient isolated sums of chains in the same even number s of variables, with orders 2 and 3. Their real Seifert forms are isomorphic, and their integral monodromy modules are isomorphic. Both monodromies have odd order dividing m = 312 · 5 · 7, and neither has eigenvalue 1.
